    AI Overview
    The Kennedy Space Center (KSC) is located on Merritt Island, Florida, on the state's Atlantic coast. Situated in Brevard County, it lies near Cape Canaveral and the town of Titusville, roughly midway between Miami and Jacksonville. It is accessible via the Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex. 
    Key Details Regarding Location: 
    • Location: Merritt Island, Florida (often associated with Cape Canaveral).
    • Proximity: Roughly 20-25 minutes away from Titusville and Cocoa Beach.
    • Landmark: It is located directly adjacent to Cape Canaveral Space Force Station. 
    Visitor Information: 
    • The Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex is located on State Road 405, Titusville, FL.
    • The site features the Apollo/Saturn V Center, accessible via a bus tour, and the Space Shuttle Atlantis exhibit.

    AI Overview
    Kennedy Space Center is located on Merritt Island, Florida. While it has a Cape Canaveral mailing address (32953) and is adjacent to the Cape Canaveral Space Force Station, it is technically situated on Merritt Island, located along Florida's Space Coast, about 34 miles east of Orlando. 
    Key Details: 
    • Location: Merritt Island, FL.
    • Nearby Cities: Titusville (north) and Cape Canaveral (south).
    • Visitor Complex Location: The Visitor Complex is also located on Merritt Island.
    • Region: Brevard County, often referred to as the Space Coast.

      Description

      The Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex is the visitor center at NASA's Kennedy Space Center on Merritt Island, Florida. It features exhibits and displays, historic spacecraft and memorabilia, shows, two IMAX theaters, and a range of bus tours of the spaceport. Wikipedia
      Departments: Apollo/Saturn V Center
      Address: Space Commerce Wy, Merritt Island, FL 32953
      Area: 42 acres
      Opened: August 1, 1967
      Phone: (855) 433-4210
